name: Orias
source:
After learning that feeding on the souls of others keeps him young, he kills angels to feed on their souls and stay young. When he looks more than 20 years old in human terms, he feels afraid of getting old, so he tries to get younger and younger.

He is a devil of a different nature with no loyalties and aims to consume the soul of Leviathan one day.
